verdict.rationale: Low-level engine tuning is a fair question for a local LLM runtime, but nothing in the evidence documents any Ollama setting for mlock, mmap, or similar engine options. One community report (ollama-comm-13) says Ollama hides llama.cpp's server configs and won't let users enable mlock, in favor of its own 'sane defaults'. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
